profile.headline: Google Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior software engineer at Google working out of Boulder, Colorado

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Development of the Google Ads SDK used by Android and iPhone app developers.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Assist in teaching Database Systems, a graduate level course covering relational databases and the MySQL language.
•	Coordinate semester project focusing on the process of designing and implementing a MySQL database.
•	Responsible for writing homework and test problems and grading student solutions.
•	Provide feedback and comments for improvement on written assignments.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Design and develop StarExec, an NSF-funded web service for the University of Iowa computer science department. The service provides a platform for users to distribute and run large-scale jobs on a 192 node cluster.
•	Utilize a wide variety of technologies including HTML, JavaScript with JQuery, AJAX, CSS, Java, JSP, MySQL, and Bash.
•	Interact directly with users in an online forum to discuss new feature requests and bug reports.
•	Collaborate with other developers in weekly meetings to review code and integrate new features.
•	Implemented an integration testing framework to ensure system correctness and stability.
•	Created a StarExec Java API, allowing users to access the StarExec server programmatically.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Development of internal monitoring systems for the Ad Traffic Quality team.

positions.title: Computer Science Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Created a tool used to convert representations of finite automata from the OCaml language to Agda, a programming language that supports writing mathematical proofs.
•	Utilized formal methods of software engineering to validate functional specifications automatically.
•	Developed skills in parsing programming languages and using the functional programming paradigm.

positions.title: Chemistry Laboratory Assistant
positions.description:
•	Investigated medical and environmental applications of highly porous chemical structures.
•	Presented data and conclusions verbally to faculty members and participated in research presentations to University members.
•	Co-authored a published paper on controlled drug delivery titled “Controlled Release of 5-Fluorouracil from HY Zeolites with Varying SiO2/Al2O3 Ratios.”

honors.title: Ernest R. Johnson Memorial Prize
honors.description: Award granted to the student with the highest academic standing in the graduating class of the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Iowa · May 2014

projects.title: Kind Web Front End
projects.description: This was an individual project to create a web front end for the Kind tool. The website allows users to enter Lustre code and submit it to the Kind property checker, which rigorously checks properties of the submitted code. The front end receives XML-formatted results from Kind, formats those results, and displays them to uses.
